title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena, Springfield
description: Winter Jam is a Christian music and worship night featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red and NewSong, with a message from speaker Zane Black and a Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous and Mary-Clair. Entry is a $15 donation at the door with no advance tickets required; parking is $20, or $50 for premium, and Jam Nation members get early entry. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, with doors at 6:00 PM and the show starting at 7:00 PM.
